result.topic_en: The scan shows the end of the previous paper on p. 156, about primitive roots and counting numbers prime to 2q, and the opening of E555 on p. 157, which explains that interpolation seeks a curve through given points and that even infinitely many points do not determine such a curve uniquely.

DE EXIMIO VSV
METHODI INTERPOLATIONVM
IN SERIERVM DOCTRINA.

In methodo interpolationum eiusmodi relatio inter binas
variabiles $x$ et $y$ quaeritur, vt si alteri $x$ successiue
dati valores $a, b, c, d,$ etc. tribuantur, altera $y$ inde
quoque datos valores $p, q, r, s,$ etc. sortiatur; seu quod
eodem redit, aequatio pro eiusmodi linea curua quaeritur,
quae per quotcunque puncta data transeat. Quo maior
ergo fuerit horum punctorum numerus, eo magis linea
curua limitatur: interim tamen iam alia occasione obser-
uaui, etiamsi punctorum numerus in infinitum augeatur,
curnam per ea transeuntem non prorsus determinari, sed
semper infinitas adhuc lineas curuas exhiberi posse, quae
aeque per cuncta eadem puncta sint transiturae. Quare
cum methodus interpolationum pro quouis casu lineam
curuam suppeditet determinatam, solutio haec semper pro
maxime particulari erit habenda: verum haec ipsa circum-
stantia singularem quandam indolem solutionis inuentae
innuit, quae accuratiorem considerationem meretur. In-
primis autem ista solutionis indoles pendet a ratione, qua
interpolatio instituitur, seu a forma, quae aequationi ge-
nerali tribuitur, in qua aequationem quaesitam contineri

items.quote: Quod autem ad multitudinem horum numerorum $a$ attinet, obseruo eam quouis casu $p=2q+1$ aequalem esse multitudini eorum numerorum ipso $p$ minorum, qui sunt ad $2q$ primi
items.english: As for the multitude of these numbers a, I observe that in each case p=2q+1 it equals the multitude of those numbers less than p which are prime to 2q.

items.quote: Haec formalis[?] consideratio viam aperiet pro quouis casu hos numeros inuestigandi.
items.english: This formal consideration will open a way to investigate these numbers in any case.

items.quote: aequatio pro eiusmodi linea curua quaeritur, quae per quotcunque puncta data transeat
items.english: An equation is sought for a curve of such a kind that it passes through any number of given points.

items.quote: etiamsi punctorum numerus in infinitum augeatur, curnam per ea transeuntem non prorsus determinari, sed semper infinitas adhuc lineas curuas exhiberi posse, quae aeque per cuncta eadem puncta sint transiturae
items.english: Even if the number of points is increased to infinity, the curve passing through them is not completely determined; infinitely many curves can still always be exhibited that pass equally through all the same points.

items.quote: Inprimis autem ista solutionis indoles pendet a ratione, qua interpolatio instituitur, seu a forma, quae aequationi generali tribuitur
items.english: Above all, this character of the solution depends on the manner in which the interpolation is carried out, that is, on the form given to the general equation.
